aspect: The refusals, stated at head-of-state level
description: Egypt said it would not solve regional problems at its own expense and would not receive refugees from Gaza; President Sisi stated this on 21 October 2023. King Abdullah II called sending Palestinian refugees to Jordan a 'red line', saying 'No refugees in Jordan, no refugees in Egypt.'

aspect: The reason is not indifference and does not help
description: The refusal rests on refusing to complete a displacement that would be permanent. The reasoning is coherent and the effect on a family under bombardment is that there is nowhere to go.
energy_note: Refused entry for your own long-term good.

aspect: 'Palestinians do not dissolve into the Arab sea'
description: The regional framing - that Palestinians are not to be absorbed - is protective of the claim and total in its cost to the individual, who is a person and not a claim.
energy_note: A nation's rights, paid for by one woman's week.
